meta.name: qa
meta.description: Exercise the delivered customer journey using real runtime or browser evidence. Use for functional acceptance testing after implementation, including failure paths.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把交付的功能按真实用户路径跑一遍,拿到能复现的验收结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果功能刚写完,还没人按真实用户的操作路径完整验收过。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the feature just shipped but no one has run the full user journey yet.

howto.what: Claude 会拿真实运行环境或浏览器里的证据,把交付的客户旅程实际跑一遍做功能验收,失败路径也包含在内。查不到的能力或没跑的检查会如实说明,不假装通过。
howto.when: 实现完成后的功能验收测试时触发,包含失败路径的检查。若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前的净化数据包和范围,不重做设置或重问已答问题。

say.text: 对刚交付的客户旅程做一次功能验收测试,失败的路径也走一遍。
say.note: 按真实运行/浏览器证据逐项跑,如实报告。

say.text: 这段实现上线前的验收检查帮我跑一下,出错场景也要覆盖。
say.note: 按方法流程执行,没跑到的检查会说明。

say.text: 接着 @fde 的净化数据包继续做验收,别再重新设置。
say.note: 沿用既有范围和已答问题。

howto.what_en: Claude runs the delivered customer journey end to end using real runtime or browser evidence, performing functional acceptance testing including failure paths. Missing capabilities or checks not run are reported honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggered for functional acceptance testing after implementation, including failure paths. When called by @fde, it reuses the current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Run a functional acceptance test on the delivered journey, failure paths too.
say_en.note: Runs each item against real runtime/browser evidence.

say_en.text: Run the pre-release acceptance checks for this implementation, including errors.
say_en.note: Executes the method and flags any checks it could not run.

say_en.text: Continue from @fde's sanitized packet for acceptance; don't restart setup.
say_en.note: Reuses the existing scope and answered questions.
